name: mantic-MCP
headline: mantic-MCP: Mautic 7 Marketing Automation
short_description: A comprehensive Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides full integration with Mautic marketing automation platform.
author: Cbrown35

sections.overview:
mantic-MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that connects AI agents to Mautic 7 (Columba Edition) marketing automation platform. It provides 68 tools across contact management, campaign orchestration, email operations, form handling, and segment management. The server supports both API v1 (FOSRestBundle) and v2 (API Platform) endpoints, enabling users to automate marketing workflows through natural language commands. Features include campaign import/export, segment-based email sending, campaign analytics, project organization, and contact lifecycle management with OAuth2 authentication. Marketing teams and automation specialists can use this to streamline campaign creation, contact segmentation, email distribution, and cross-environment campaign deployment.
Search and filter contacts by criteria, then add them to campaigns or segments
Clone campaigns between environments and export/import complete campaign setups
Create and manage landing pages, forms, and track form submissions
Send targeted emails to segments with real-time audience adaptation
GreenTech Solutions, a renewable energy company, aims to enhance its marketing automation through Mautic's MCP integration. This plan leverages customer data from their CRM and website analytics to create targeted campaigns.
